caption: The video depicts a man in a light-blue dress shirt and patterned navy tie standing behind a dark glossy table, with a white projection screen and a wooden door behind him. His right hand is raised to face height, pinching a small dark sphere between thumb and forefinger, while his left hand rests flat on the tabletop. A second identical sphere sits motionless on the table to the viewer's right. He holds the raised sphere steady with his mouth open as if speaking. The sphere then separates from his hand, dropping vertically down the front of his shirt beside the tie. It reaches the table surface and comes to rest at the viewer's left of the tie. His right hand stays suspended in the same raised posture and does not follow the ball down. His mouth closes, and the stationary sphere on the right never moves. The background stays fixed throughout.
relations: A sphere released from a raised hand falls vertically along the front of a person's shirt.
The falling sphere comes to rest on a glossy table surface beside the person's tie.
The releasing hand remains suspended in its initial raised posture as the sphere descends.
A second identical sphere resting on the table remains motionless throughout the dropping event.
